pythonFunction.name: get_rebate_claim_status
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the status of the customer's rebate claims (a mock tracker: Received, Reviewing, Approved, Paid),
one claim by its number or the most recent first. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak
a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    claim_id: Claim number such as RB-3001; leave empty for all claims of the account.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, claims (claim_id, program_name, amount, status, steps, submitted_on, note), card (the
    show_claim_status_card arguments of the first claim), spoken_summary and agent_action.
